sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Nausea ; sour eructations ; hiccough ; pain
and distress.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Gas, fullness and distention, colicky pain
and uneasiness. Light colored diarrhoea.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Seminal emissions and impotency, with fear
of never being better.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Night-terrors; sleeplessness; sudden wake-
fulness; frightful dreams.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Twitchings of muscles; must be mov-
ing. Chorea. Tremors. Sharp stinging pains in up-
per extremities. Nightly restlessness. Weakness and
aching.
